name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.difference_average
type_text:
∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
            (O :
              OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n))
            (seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K) (ω : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k),
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => O.answer 1 a (0, r) (ω a)) →
              ∀ (batch firstID : ℕ) (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d) (clock : NNReal),
                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O seed ω batch = some (false, x, y, clock, firstID) →
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.batchResult q O seed ω batch =
                    (↑q.S)⁻¹ •
                      ∑ j,
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O seed ω batch j).elim 0 fun i =>
                          gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y
